raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 주말 식물 마켓을 홍보해줘. SNS에 올릴 16:9 가로 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 각각 전체 스타일과 레이아웃이 달랐으면 좋겠어. 식물을 고르고 집에서 돌보는 즐거움이 느껴지도록 만들고, 긴 설명과 방문 안내가 자연스럽게 읽히게 해줘. 큰 고딕 제목과 정보 블록에 작은 이미지나 질감을 붙이는 단색 템플릿은 제외해줘. 로고·QR·새 문구 없이 다음 문구를 각 한 번씩 정확히 넣어줘.

집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
성수 주말 식물 마켓
2027.06.12–06.13
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial review using only the explicitly pinned inputs. Read the literal packet/case, rubric/rules/addendum/method, and all five pinned native-evidence manifests before opening poster images; no source assets or protected layouts are declared. In packet order M1 through M5, opened and visually inspected native, usage720, thumbnail320 for each member via tools.view_image with detail original and forwarded its actual returned image at original detail. Completed all fifteen exact poster views before beginning the first poster-copy reading/transcription stage, any judgment, or any score. These are actual visual-open attestations, not inferences from hashes or helper success. Recorded all twelve first readings per member from the already opened images in packet copy order, without OCR or a substituted asset; no ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed. Assessed all seven dimensions and the complete ordered set independently. No image production/editing, peer or maker inspection, spawning, resuming, forking, or invented event/session ID. Verified exact pinned bytes and PNG dimensions separately; all natives are 1672x941, accepted for 16:9 by the declared nearest-integer-single-edge policy (height deviation 0.5 px), not mathematically exact; usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180, within their declared limits.

issues: The complete set does not achieve five genuinely distinct whole visual systems; this member and M4 share a pale opening within surrounding plants, serif title treatment, and detached supporting information. M2 also retains the left-title/right-event route.

evidence.location: entire frame
evidence.observation: An open-style, single flat photographic poster fills its landscape canvas with large healthy indoor leaves and a row of potted specimens; no tape material is required. There is no observed logo, watermark, QR, extra wording, or mockup frame.

evidence.location: left title, center explanation, lower-right event column
evidence.observation: The long explanation is readable in a center opening and visit details read down the ruled right column; the visible plant selection is substantial and connects the small-forest title to healthy home plants. The image is integral to the composition, rather than a tiny ornament on a solid gothic information template.

evidence.location: pale openings surrounded by foliage
evidence.observation: The foliage-framed pale text areas and serif heading resemble M4's overall system; the left title and right-hand visit block also resemble M2's reading route. M3 and M5 introduce stronger changes, leaving the complete five-direction condition unmet.

evidence.observation: Substantial plant forms, containers, visible roots, and care equipment occupy most of the image and are essential to the composition.

evidence.location: right pot cutaway and lower-left soil/tool/cloth
evidence.observation: The root cutaway makes below-soil plant structure visible, and the soil and tools connect it to repotting and care; the surrounding plant varieties support choosing plants of different sizes.

content_form.location: right root cutaway and left/bottom varied pots

hierarchy.location: whole frame

space.location: left pale reading aperture and large right tree

image_material.location: bark, leaf veins, blue ceramic pot, tool and tree root cutaway

emotion_control.location: warm cream opening and cared-for pots/tools

ai_slop.location: bench props, draped cloth and illustrated root/soil structure

hierarchy.location: center panel and bottom-left branding

typography.location: large slogan and bottom-left small slogan
typography.observation: The same supplied phrase occupies two different type roles, violating the exact once-only requirement. The individual glyphs are otherwise legible.

typography.location: center explanation, lower access/care and invitation/URL columns
typography.observation: These lines are very small, particularly the two lower columns. Thin light-on-dark support text has insufficient size for comfortable full-copy reading.

space.location: center dark panel below oversized slogan
space.observation: The large slogan consumes much of the panel; explanation, event information, and two small closing columns are compressed below it. The plentiful image area and panel boundaries do not translate into enough breathing room for the complete visiting guidance.

image_material.location: lower-right hands, rooted plant and terracotta pot
image_material.observation: The hands grip the plant and container coherently, roots remain attached to the soil ball, and light and pot surfaces match the warm market scene. The three image crops maintain a consistent photographic/painterly texture.

emotion_control.location: sunlit browsing and repotting panels
emotion_control.observation: Warm light, abundant choices, and close hands-on care produce an inviting and active plant-tending mood. The dark center panel gives the lively images a stable visual anchor.

ai_slop.location: center heading and repeated bottom-left slogan
ai_slop.observation: The duplicated slogan is a concrete unresolved repetition, assigning the same phrase two unrequested roles and undermining the precision of the otherwise coherent image-panel construction.

residuals: The slogan is visibly duplicated; the raw first reading preserves the dominant center occurrence and the layout observation records the second occurrence.

The central information panel is compressed by the oversized slogan and the narrow closing columns.

recording_adapter.limit: Metadata bindings and attestations do not prove semantic viewing or source fidelity

evidence.location: left title, center explanation, right visit column amid plants
evidence.observation: M1 uses a pale photographic reading opening framed by leaves and pots, serif title at left, explanation near center, and visiting information at right. It shares the foliage/pale-opening/serif system with M4 and the left-title/right-event route with M2.

evidence.location: upper-left title/description and lower-right table opening
evidence.observation: People browsing and handling a pot, orange accents, and bold type make M2 more active than M1 and M4. Its spatial route still places title/explanation left and event details at lower-right, similar to M1; changing rendering and participants does not establish five entirely different systems.

evidence.location: top date, center information pockets, low title, encircling plants
evidence.observation: M3 changes the type priority to a top date and lower title, with explanation and support in distinct irregular foliage pockets. Its layered shapes, pink pots, navy/green type and compartmentalized route are real differences from M1/M2/M4, though the long narrative route is fragmented.

evidence.location: left pale text opening and large tree at right
evidence.observation: M4 shifts to detailed botanical rendering, roots and care props, with horizontal event rows beneath a serif title stack. The pale foliage-framed opening, serif title/Latin/explanation hierarchy and warm green/cream relationship nevertheless closely echo M1; these two do not form wholly independent directions.

evidence.location: left plant strip, upper browsing strip, center dark copy panel, right care panel
evidence.observation: M5 introduces a distinct panel grid, cropped care action, dark central text field and small low branding rather than the earlier pale openings. The layout and content sequence are substantially different, but its repeated slogan and tiny copy weaken execution and its presence does not resolve the M1/M4 and M1/M2 overlap.

residuals: The set contains meaningful differences, especially M3's date-first foliage pockets and M5's action-panel grid, but it does not resolve five genuinely distinct whole visual systems.

M1 and M4 share the foliage-framed pale reading opening and serif title/explanation/information system; M2 repeats M1's left-title/right-event route despite different participants, rendering and type.
M3's fragmented reading route, M4's fine usage-size guidance, and M5's duplicated slogan and compressed small guidance remain in the record; no averaging or member omission was used.

hierarchy.location: top date, center-left paragraph, center-right access block, bottom-left title
hierarchy.observation: The date and market open the sequence, but the explanation, support, and title occupy separate unconnected pockets. After the center-left paragraph the reader must choose between the lower title and the right-hand invitation; the full message does not settle into one natural route.

hierarchy.location: upper date and lower-left title
hierarchy.observation: The date strongly competes with the displaced title, while the Latin name is attached to the lower title rather than the event entry.

typography.location: center-left five-line explanation and right support block
typography.observation: Bold navy glyphs and word-boundary wraps preserve the long explanation. The lower Latin name wraps before the ampersand without losing its word structure.
The explanation, hours, care, invitation, and URL retain strong contrast and readable separation, although the uniform bold body weight offers little modulation.

space.location: pale openings and right pink containers
space.observation: The leaf masses establish deliberately irregular apertures for information and counterbalance the pink pots at right. Text is kept clear of the enclosing silhouettes, with the date above and title below.

image_material.location: left monstera cutouts, trailing top vine and pink pot surfaces
image_material.observation: Layered leaf edges, shadows, veins, and subtle paper texture are consistent across the plant system. Distinct leaf forms and attached stems keep the stylization coherent.

emotion_control.location: lime foliage, navy shadows, cream openings and pink pots
emotion_control.observation: The color rhythm and enveloping foliage produce an upbeat, abundant indoor garden feeling. The high contrast preserves the informational purpose within that energy.

ai_slop.location: foliage/pot junctions around the right and bottom openings
ai_slop.observation: The repeated leaf forms are grounded in a plant collection, with visible containers and coherent layering. No arbitrary badges, pseudo-labels, or extraneous print interrupt the system.

residuals: The reading route is fragmented among four foliage openings; the date and lower title compete instead of establishing a settled narrative sequence.
The body uses an almost uniformly bold treatment; it is legible but has limited typographic modulation.
Care and selection are implied through thriving plant variety rather than visible actions.
Its locally different arrangement does not resolve the complete set's M1/M4 and M1/M2 repetition.
Native 1672x941 satisfies 16:9 only through the declared integer-edge rounding allowance.

{"mode": "open", "invocation_interpretation": "Skill invocation is not a tape material requirement"}

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Each copy entry once with exact Korean/Latin/numbers/punctuation and meaningful word spaces. No extra print, logo, watermark or QR.
Five independent single flat opaque landscape16:9 posters, not mockups or a comparison sheet.
Five genuinely distinct whole visual systems in spatial organization, image editing, type roles and reading routes, not different media over a common scaffold.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visuals express choosing and caring for living houseplants.
Full explanation and market,date,hours,place,access,care,invitation,URL comfortably readable and naturally connected at usage720.

ratio.dimension_source: exact packet native-view metadata; frozen summary independently checks native PNG header

evidence.location: large tree/root illustration at right and potted foliage at bottom
evidence.observation: Substantial plant forms, containers, visible roots, and care equipment occupy most of the image and are essential to the composition.

evidence.location: right pot cutaway and lower-left soil/tool/cloth
evidence.observation: The root cutaway makes below-soil plant structure visible, and the soil and tools connect it to repotting and care; the surrounding plant varieties support choosing plants of different sizes.

content_form.location: right root cutaway and left/bottom varied pots
content_form.observation: The visible root system, care tool, soil, and watering can substantiate the care theme, while different plant scales support the explanation about small pots and long-grown trees.

hierarchy.location: large left title versus left-center event/support rows
hierarchy.observation: The title and enormous right tree establish the main anchors, but the market and practical guidance shrink into fine horizontal rows; they no longer have adequate emphasis for the stated SNS visiting use.

hierarchy.location: whole frame
hierarchy.observation: The tree and title remain prominent while the information group becomes an indistinct patch.

typography.observation: Serif glyphs and soft wrapping are intact, and the headline/Latin treatment is coherent.
The thin strokes and very small supporting copy demand close inspection. The full explanation and visiting guidance are not comfortably readable at the supplied size.

space.location: left pale reading aperture and large right tree
space.observation: The canopy and peripheral plants reserve an intentional text aperture, while the event rows align and the left care equipment balances the tree and blue pot. There is enough clear area to improve type scale without changing the image concept.

image_material.location: bark, leaf veins, blue ceramic pot, tool and tree root cutaway
image_material.observation: The botanical rendering maintains consistent detailed line-and-wash surfaces. The root illustration visibly connects the trunk to soil within the pot, and care props sit coherently on the bench.

emotion_control.location: warm cream opening and cared-for pots/tools
emotion_control.observation: Warm botanical detail, worn ceramic and wood, and the practical care equipment create a patient, tactile sense of tending plants at home. The image's restraint has a content-specific purpose.

ai_slop.location: bench props, draped cloth and illustrated root/soil structure
ai_slop.observation: The props relate to tending plants and the detailed surfaces are consistent. The root cutaway reads as an explanatory botanical device rather than arbitrary ornament or a stray image fragment.

residuals: Fine supporting copy and horizontal grouping leave access, care, invitation, and URL uncomfortable at usage720; native readability does not cure that use-size limit.
The large tree and title overwhelm practical information at thumbnail scale.
M1 and this member share a pale foliage-framed serif title/explanation/information system despite their different rendering and event arrangement.
Native 1672x941 uses the declared 0.5 px single-edge ratio allowance and is not mathematically exact 16:9.

procedure.method: Independent fresh craft session; no spawn, fork, resume or peer/producer/planner inspection. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, compact method/addendum and adapter. Verified the declared hashes/byte counts and PNG headers, and read all five pinned native-evidence source_manifest files before poster viewing, without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet supplies zero source assets and zero protected layouts, so actual source opens and protected-layout reads are both zero. Then called tools.view_image through functions.exec with detail original on exactly these fifteen pinned views, sequentially: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. All fifteen returned image renders were actually inspected before the first deliberate text-reading/transcription stage, mandatory judgment, image score or diversity score. Native views are 1672x941; use views 720x405; thumbnails 320x180, all matching packet headers. Text was read from those rendered pixels after the complete opening pass, without OCR, substitute assets, crops or inferred omitted copy. No ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed or performed. Native ratio is not mathematically exact 16:9: abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5 pixel, so all five pass the predeclared nearest-integer-single-edge policy. The smaller views preserve aspect to integer pixels. Runtime session identity is unavailable here and remains null; no serialized tool event or opening/session ID is claimed.

Literal client styles:
{"mode": "open", "invocation_interpretation": "Skill invocation is not a tape material requirement"}

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Each copy entry once with exact Korean/Latin/numbers/punctuation and meaningful word spaces. No extra print, logo, watermark or QR.
Five independent single flat opaque landscape16:9 posters, not mockups or a comparison sheet.
Five genuinely distinct whole visual systems in spatial organization, image editing, type roles and reading routes, not different media over a common scaffold.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visuals express choosing and caring for living houseplants.
Full explanation and market,date,hours,place,access,care,invitation,URL comfortably readable and naturally connected at usage720.
Exclude passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information templates with subordinate imagery, tiny-image/texture/font substitution or empty-room dressing. Gothic and coherent image-led scenes permitted; no composition override.

ratio.dimension_source: exact packet native-view metadata; frozen summary independently checks native PNG header

evidence.location: central table and two people
evidence.observation: People, large plants, varied containers and equipment occupy most of the frame; the scene is substantive nonglyph market content rather than decoration attached to type.

evidence.location: shopper inspecting red-flowered plants and grower handling a tree
evidence.observation: The interaction communicates browsing and learning from a grower; nearby watering can, trowel, soil and spare pots make home care tangible.

content_form.location: two people and potting table
content_form.observation: The shopper's attentive lean and the grower's visible handling of a pot turn the supplied promise into a clear market encounter. Small pots, a larger tree, watering equipment and soil connect selection with subsequent care.

hierarchy.location: upper-left type stack and lower-right event block
hierarchy.observation: The bold Korean title, Latin brand and orange tagline establish a clear entry above the explanation. The diagonal across the table leads to the grower and then the event block; date, hours and place are easy to pick out, with orange invitation above the URL.

hierarchy.location: title, human scene and tabletop event anchor
hierarchy.observation: The main title and the people remain identifiable, and the right-hand event block retains its placement after reduction.

typography.observation: Crisp Korean/Latin glyphs, controlled bold sans-serif roles and three complete paragraph lines give the copy a consistent voice. The breaks do not cut words.

Supporting lines remain distinct against the pale table, with date/hours larger than access/care and the invitation separated by orange color. The visible middle-dot gaps are optical spacing, not missing words.

space.location: left pale text pocket and right tabletop pocket
space.observation: The left paragraph stops above the shopper's head; the market block sits on an open part of the table below the grower's hands. These pockets preserve readable space while the plants and table join the two halves into one scene.

image_material.location: grower's hands and pot, watering can, tools and leaf clusters
image_material.observation: The painted surfaces are cohesive, container rims and hand placement are legible, and the tools rest on the table with consistent warm light. Branches, leaves and the varied pot sizes provide credible material differences without breaking the illustrative construction.

emotion_control.location: shopper and smiling grower
emotion_control.observation: Open facial expressions, attentive browsing and warm greenhouse light make participation feel friendly and unhurried. Red flowers and orange invitation text add energy while the green plant mass holds the scene together.

ai_slop.location: people, plant stems and tabletop objects
ai_slop.observation: The visible human interaction is understandable, stems terminate in containers, and care objects have recognizable functions and placement. No definite extra wording, obvious hand failure or contradictory object intersection was observed.

residuals: The Korean title and Latin brand both carry heavy weight; the opening has less typographic nuance than an exceptional five-point treatment.
The secondary logistics are compact, although readable on the light tabletop at usage720.
No supplied reference assets or protected geometry exist for an external fidelity comparison.

layout.observations: Two title lines in the pale bottom-left opening, rather than at the upper entry point.
Two lines to the right of the bottom-left Korean title; the line break precedes the ampersand.
One green line at the top of the mid-left explanation pocket.

procedure.method: Independent assessment in this fresh session; no spawn, fork, resume, peer review, producer inspection, or unlisted embedded path was used. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rubric, rules, recording addendum/method, adapter, ratio policy, and all five pinned production manifests. Verified exact input hashes/bytes and PNG-header dimensions without treating those checks as viewing. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts, so there were zero source opens and zero protected-layout reads. Actually opened and visually inspected the fifteen exact PNGs via tools.view_image with detail original, emitted through functions.exec, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, and M5 in that same view order. All fifteen rendered views were seen before the first poster copy transcription, judgment, or score. First readings were then retained from the viewed pixels, including soft line breaks and M5's two slogan occurrences. Two later exact-native opens were made only for the recorded ambiguities: M3 title word spacing, and M5 date/hours range punctuation; each affected entry has one revisit and preserves its first raw reading. No image was created, edited, cropped, substituted, or rescaled by this critic. Native dimensions are 1672x941 for all five; 16:9 is satisfied by nearest-integer-single-edge rounding because abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5, not by mathematical exactness. Usage views are 720x405 and thumbnails 320x180, with the manifest's aspect-preserving integer-edge downsampling. Session identity is not observable here and remains null; no invented opening or event ID is claimed.

{"mode": "open", "invocation_interpretation": "Skill invocation is not a tape material requirement"}

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Each copy entry once with exact Korean/Latin/numbers/punctuation and meaningful word spaces. No extra print, logo, watermark or QR.
Five independent single flat opaque landscape16:9 posters, not mockups or a comparison sheet.
Five genuinely distinct whole visual systems in spatial organization, image editing, type roles and reading routes, not different media over a common scaffold.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visuals express choosing and caring for living houseplants.
Full explanation and market,date,hours,place,access,care,invitation,URL comfortably readable and naturally connected at usage720.

ratio.dimension_source: exact packet native-view metadata; frozen summary independently checks native PNG header

evidence.location: human figures and densely stocked tabletop
evidence.observation: Large illustrated people, pots, foliage, and gardening tools constitute the dominant visual scene rather than texture or tiny ornaments.

evidence.location: left customer studying the plants and right grower holding a planter
evidence.observation: The depicted attention to plants, grower's welcoming expression, and visible tools make selection, advice, and care concrete and joyful.

content_form.location: two figures around central table
content_form.observation: Looking closely at plants and handling a pot translate choosing and growing into a visible interaction; small pots, a taller tree, and gardening tools also support the explanation's range of plant sizes.

hierarchy.location: upper-left heading and lower-right visit block
hierarchy.observation: The title, Latin line, orange slogan, and explanation form one clear entry group, while the date/hours/place sequence is isolated against the table clearing; the scene connects those groups.

hierarchy.location: title at upper left and two figures
hierarchy.observation: The title and relationship between shopper and grower remain clear; the small details stay subordinate to that story.

typography.observation: Strong gothic display type is balanced by smaller, open supporting lines and orange emphasis; complete copy is crisp and not intersected by plant silhouettes.

The full paragraph can be read without crossing foliage, and distinct baselines preserve access, care, invitation, and URL. The long Latin display line is heavy but does not erase the Korean headline.

space.location: upper-left light opening and lower-right table surface
space.observation: Two clear text areas are sized around the narrative, with the central plant cluster connecting them; the lean of the customer and angle of the tabletop guide the eye instead of leaving a generic blank half.

image_material.location: grower's hands/pot, customer profile, and tools on table
image_material.observation: The illustrated anatomy, pot contact, expressive faces, watering can, and trowel are legible and share a coherent warm, painterly treatment; sunlight and overlapping plants maintain usable depth.

emotion_control.location: smiling grower and interested customer
emotion_control.observation: Relaxed expressions, the gentle lean toward the plants, warm gold/green relationships, and small orange accents communicate an accessible weekend market with attentive care.

ai_slop.location: tabletop utensils, plants, and two figures
ai_slop.observation: The props have recognizable purposes, hands relate to the pot, and plant overlaps support the scene; no extraneous labels, repeated slogan, or arbitrary visual badge is visible.

residuals: The Latin title is almost as forceful as the Korean title and leaves little display-scale contrast between those two lines.
Some tabletop planting detail becomes visually dense at thumbnail320, though the central interaction survives.
The green/gold foliage and light text clearing overlap the broad palette convention used elsewhere in the set.

content_form.location: whole leaf-and-pot field

space.location: four irregular cream openings and plants between them
space.observation: The oversized leaves, trailing vines, and pots shape deliberate negative-space pockets sized to the text groups; the uneven botanical borders and pink pot mass create balanced occupied/clear relationships.

hierarchy.location: central slogan, paragraph, and lower visit groups
hierarchy.observation: The very large slogan consumes the top of the copy panel while the actual Korean title is relegated to the small bottom-left strip; practical information below has little scale contrast and the long reading route is compressed.

hierarchy.location: central slogan versus bottom-left title
hierarchy.observation: The slogan dominates; the title/brand and participation details become minor traces, and the repeated small slogan offers no helpful hierarchy.

typography.location: center headline and bottom-left brand strip
typography.observation: The large serif Hangul slogan is cleanly shaped, but the same complete slogan is repeated below LEAVES & LIVING, breaching the once-only copy condition.
The paragraph, access/care lines, and bottom-right invitation/URL shrink to tight small type. Their strong contrast helps, but comfortable extended reading remains unresolved.

space.location: center dark panel, two lower columns, and left brand strip
space.observation: The image grid is deliberate, but the outsized center slogan leaves the required explanation/support in a compressed lower area; the brand strip is squeezed against the bottom edge and carries redundant copy.

image_material.location: repotting hands/root ball and upper selection scene
image_material.observation: Warm, textured plant rendering, coherent pot contact, visible roots and soil, and consistent sunlit surfaces hold up locally; image crops give clear actions rather than mere material decoration.

emotion_control.location: sunlit market row and hands caring for plant
emotion_control.observation: Golden light, dense living plants, and close hands-on activity convey both browsing pleasure and attentive plant care; the dark-green panel contains the imagery's energy.

ai_slop.location: large center slogan and small bottom-left slogan
ai_slop.observation: The same complete slogan is redundantly printed in two disconnected roles, producing an unresolved copy/composition artifact despite coherent plant and hand rendering.

ai_slop.location: bottom-left brand strip and center support blocks
ai_slop.observation: The tiny repeated slogan and crowded support type show incomplete editing of the assembled layout; the defect is visible duplication and scale allocation, not a presumed medium problem.

residuals: The slogan appears twice; both actual occurrences are preserved in the first raw reading.
The center slogan's size displaces the long explanation and visit support into small type.
The bottom-left title/brand placement is secondary to the slogan and contains an unnecessary second slogan.
The care and selection imagery is strong, but the assembled typography/copy is unfinished at usage720.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: Three pale text openings are enclosed by a photographic leaf close-up and low plant bench: serif Korean title at left, explanation in the middle, visit column at right. M2 also starts left and finishes right, but its human/table narrative replaces the close-up enclosure and moves the explanation under the headline.

evidence.location: customer at lower left, central tabletop, grower at right, and two copy zones
evidence.observation: The viewer follows the interested shopper across a diagonal table toward the grower and lower-right visit block. The large gothic/Latin heading plus orange accents and illustrated interaction create a different role for the image and type than M1's quiet photographic clearings or M4's single serif copy clearing.

evidence.location: top date, center/right islands, bottom-left title, and right pots
evidence.observation: Oversized graphic foliage shapes multiple irregular text pockets; the date is the upper focal point and the title sits at bottom left. This reverse hierarchy and distributed route differ from M1/M2's title-first left-to-right approach and M4's unified group, beyond a change of paper texture.

evidence.location: single upper/left text clearing beside right tree and exposed roots
evidence.observation: Title, brand, slogan, paragraph, and compact visit rows form one contiguous reading area, while a large tree/root study and foreground tools provide the image emphasis. Unlike M2, the care topic is a botanical detail rather than people interacting; unlike M3, text does not occupy separate islands.

evidence.location: straight panel boundaries and central slogan block
evidence.observation: A tall left foliage strip, wide top selection scene, lower-right repotting close-up, and dark center panel produce a grid. The slogan leads and the title/brand sits at the left bottom, changing the route and image editing from all four botanical-field compositions. Large action crops give this layout substantive visual relationships despite its copy and scale defects.

residuals: The five members differ in actual spatial organization, image roles/crops, type priorities, and reading routes enough for diversity 4; the shared green foliage, warm light, and pale/dark plant-associated text fields limit exceptional breadth.

M1 and M2 have a related left-entry/right-visit tendency, so their separation relies partly on close-up enclosure versus a two-person table narrative; the specific differences are recorded rather than inferred from media labels.
Diversity and exact count do not erase M3's title-space failure, M4's small usage-scale support, or M5's duplicate slogan and compressed support typography.
This is one independent portfolio critic of the pinned initial five only. No supplied source-fidelity comparison applies, and no all-three-critic or later-stage verdict is claimed.
